[[Secondary Training]] }} Reach [[level]] five. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{Standard prerequisites |campaign = Nightfall }} ===Objectives=== * Speak to [[Second Spear Binah]] to enter [[Kamadan]]. * Hone your skills by reaching level 5. * See First Spear Dehvad for your reward. ===Reward=== * 500 [[Experience]] * 250 [[Gold]] * 10 [[Sunspear Promotion Point]]s ==Walkthrough== Complete quests or defeat enemies until you reach level 5. Talk to First Spear Dehvad for your reward. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;First Spear Dehvad :''Ahai, . How's your luck been lately? Mine's improved greatly since you helped clear out those [[corsair]] raiders. Of course, we can't rely on luck to get us through every scrape. A seasoned soldier never ignores his training. In fact, those are [[Kormir]]'s orders. All new recruits must hone their primary skills until they reach '''level five''' and then begin a rigorous training regimen in a secondary profession. We've all got to be at our best if we hope to meet the challenges that face [[Elona]]. So, come talk to me again when you reach '''level five''' and I'll get you started on your training.'' {{offer dialog |accept = I'll be back in no time! |decline = How about we play cards instead? |ask = The best way to hone your primary skills is to help some of the local people with their problems. But come back as soon as you reach '''level five'''. You don't want Kormir to see you slacking on your Sunspear duties. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;First Spear Dehvad :''Back so soon? Wow, [[Koss]] was right about you. Don't tell him I told you, but Koss called you the "Rising star of the new Order." Well, we'd better get you started on your basic training.'' ==Notes== *If you [[map travel]] to Kamadan or if you received the quest from First Spear Dehvad in Kamadan, your [[compass]] will have a starburst to talk to Binah in Kamadan, to go into [[Churrhir Fields]] and then talk to Binah again to go ''back'' into Kamadan. Your [[world map]] will also say to go back into Churrhir Fields.
